The abstract’s core hypothesis is that magnetite‑(apatite) deposits form through crystallisation of iron‑rich ultrabasic melts generated by melt–sediment interaction, melt separation, immiscibility and subsequent magnetite precipitation, with high fO₂ and associated hydrothermal fluids as secondary effects. It does not present the candidate’s focus on episodic magmatic‑hydrothermal fluid pulses with the specified isotopic ranges and analytical protocol as the primary model being tested.

VERDICT: REJECT
